dimensions.text: Unicode scalar Levenshtein by exact role/base grid start/readingOrder. Preserve spaces, punctuation, diacritics and small kana; missing/extra fields count deletion/insertion.
dimensions.fieldPosition: Exact role/start/order matching, full gridRect, markCells, logicalRect and renderUnits. No text-based pairing; missing/extra fields and visible-mark attribution remain failures.
dimensions.symbols: Presence, kind/style, gridRect, order of all cursor/down-arrow/detached symbols. SourceRect separately reported. Retain strict descriptor equality beside version-aware equality.
dimensions.state: Exact kind beside version-aware comparison. Only legacy schema1 flat-arrow complete_waiting can represent current message_complete; no other kind aliases.
dimensions.pixelBorder: Compare half-open sourceRect on every strict matched field/symbol path; missing/extra targets are not comparable, never cosmetic offsets. Keep all deltas, frozen projection checks and prior original-pixel warnings, which cannot prove glyph clipping or safety.
dimensions.logicalAgreement: Conjunction of text/fieldPosition/symbols/state only, diagnostic, not a replacement accepted page score or physical-envelope/UI qualification.

compatibility.guard: Exact frozen legacy contract SHA plus expected schemaVersion1 and flat cursor with downArrowVisible true, valid gridRect/sourceRect, no nested downArrow and no style. Never guard by clip/frame/text answer.
compatibility.arrow: Expand expected legacy flat arrow to filled_down in a derived comparison copy only. Preserve actual style, symbol presence, logical position, extra symbols and original source rectangles.
compatibility.state: Under the same guard, expected completePage true, expected kind complete_waiting and all nonempty expected regions role dialogue: compare to actual message_complete with visible down arrow. Keep original label mismatch and compatibility event. Loading, cursor, menu and clearing kinds are not aliased.

aggregation: One original frame counted once; any overlapping replay failure fails that dimension. Max edit errors across overlaps, same frozen continuous-state union and page-opportunity union as original. All scoring frames retained. Per-page dimension success requires every complete frame; transition frames and continuous transition opportunities separately listed.
checks: Independently reconstruct both stages of every original score and exact aggregate without importing production OCR or changing its scorer.
Bind all previous audit inputs, GT payloads, media, actual/build/old scores plus new helpers by SHA before/after; no new OCR/build/GT mutation.
